zh-CN.name: OLED 深色模式
zh-CN.description: 以深色表面为基础的显示方案，可在支持的 OLED 屏幕上选择黑色或近黑色背景。OLED 指屏幕技术，不是一个保证省电或提高可读性的 UI 风格名称。
use_when: 用户偏好深色主题或在低亮度环境使用。
产品需要保持深浅主题的内容与状态一致。
avoid_when: 不要直接反转所有颜色或使用刺眼的满屏白字。
功耗与观感需要在实际设备上验证。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
建立深色背景、表面和文字的层级色阶；正文使用足够对比且不过亮的色值，主操作和错误状态仍可辨认；同时提供浅色主题，不把纯黑或省电视为硬性保证。
专属演示：在真实深浅主题之间切换，并保持前景、表面和状态层级；不宣称省电。 参数：初始主题 {theme}；圆角 {corner_px}px。

en.name: Dark Mode OLED
en.description: A dark-surface display direction that may use black or near-black backgrounds on OLED screens. OLED is display technology, not a UI style that guarantees energy savings or better readability.
use_when: Users prefer a dark theme or work in low-light environments.
The product needs consistent content and states across light and dark themes.
avoid_when: Do not simply invert every color or fill the screen with glaring white text.
Validate energy use and visual comfort on actual devices.
en.prompt_template:
Define separate dark background, surface and text levels. Keep body copy legible without excessive brightness, and preserve recognizable actions and errors. Offer a light theme as well; do not promise that pure black is always preferable or saves energy.
Dedicated demonstration: Switch real dark/light themes while preserving text, surface and status hierarchy; no energy-saving claim. Parameters: initial theme {theme}; corner radius {corner_px}px.
